signals.signal: Ukrgasbank ATM purchase tender UA-2026-03-20-010151-a (expected value UAH 55,264,689 incl. VAT) closed with contract signed to TOV 'ATM sistems' (EDRPOU 44372551) at UAH 49,720,800 (-10.03%). Scope: 36 through-the-wall ATMs + 37 lobby ATMs + 8 full-cycle lobby recyclers = 81 units, delivery by 01/12/2026, 70% prepayment / 30% post-payment. Printec Ukraine LLC (EDRPOU 35442628) bid UAH 55,262,024.34 and lost by UAH 5,541,224.34; Printec filed complaint UA-2026-03-20-010151-a.a1 on 17/04/2026 alleging the winner's OEM had control/business links with Russian-registered entities - the complaint was rejected by Ukrgasbank on the merits. Clarification thread shows the recycler spec (>=5 recycling cassettes + reject/retract, >=17-inch monitor, >=1 serial port) was written to Nautilus Hyosung Monimax 8600S and Ukrgasbank refused to relax it despite bidder objections that it narrowed the field to one.
signals.source_name: Clarity Project (mirror of Prozorro tender UA-2026-03-20-010151-a)
signals.implies: Direct, quantified competitive intelligence: Printec Ukraine is actively bidding ATM hardware outside PrivatBank and just lost an 81-unit Ukrgasbank deal to ATM sistems / Nautilus Hyosung on price and on a spec written around a competitor model. Printec ATM/self-service and cash-recycling automation; the loss route (spec capture at the requirement-drafting stage) is the actionable lesson for Oschadbank's own refresh.
signals.likelihood: Contract already signed; delivery by 01/12/2026 - the re-bid window is the next Ukrgasbank cycle
signals.followup: Obtain the signed contract PDF 'Договір № ЕТ-19_26 Банкомати' and the winner's vendor authorisation letter; profile TOV 'ATM sistems' (EDRPOU 44372551) - it already holds Ukrgasbank delivery notes for 24 and 16 units plus an Alliance Bank contract; pre-position on requirement drafting at Oschadbank/Ukrgasbank before the next spec is issued.

signals.signal: Ukrgasbank ran a first attempt at the same ATM purchase (UA-2025-11-20-012352-a, same UAH 55,264,689 expected value) which ended 'unsuccessful', then re-ran it in March 2026. Separately Ukrgasbank contracted ATM NFC-module retrofits (UA-2026-07-16-002946-a, UAH 429,600, complete), Wincor ATM service (UA-2026-06-09-013744-a, UAH 172,599.46), Hyosung ATM service (UA-2025-05-30-001290-a, UAH 1,269,820), ATM safe/deposit-box repair (UA-2026-03-31-010596-a, UAH 440,250) and NCR APTRA / Solidcore Suite software support (UA-2025-01-02-002542-a, UAH 214,898.40).
signals.implies: Ukrgasbank runs a genuinely multi-vendor fleet (NCR/APTRA, Wincor, Hyosung) and buys services in small unbundled lots - a managed-services and multivendor-software consolidation target for Printec (APTRA/Kalignite-class estate management), plus contactless/NFC retrofit work.
signals.likelihood: Recurring annual service lots; next NFC/service cycle within 12 months
signals.followup: Track Ukrgasbank's zakupivli.pro commercial-tender feed (it publishes there first, then mirrors to Prozorro) for the next multivendor software-support and ATM-service lots.

signals.signal: NBU branch-network data at 01/07/2026: Ukrainian banks operated 4,754 branches vs 4,815 at 01/01/2026 (-61 in H1-2026). Oschadbank cut the most - 16 branches - but still has the largest network at 1,115; PrivatBank 1,050 (-8); Raiffeisen Bank Ukraine 282 (-10); PUMB 220. Only Acordbank (+6), MTB Bank (+3) and ASVIO Bank (+2) expanded.
signals.implies: Both target banks are shrinking branches - Raiffeisen UA is now at 282 branches, materially below the ~300-306 the baseline carried and far below RBI's 503 group figure. Branch contraction with unchanged service obligations is the classic driver for cash recyclers and assisted self-service zones - Printec cash automation, recyclers, and self-service/managed services.
signals.followup: Pull the NBU 'Основні показники діяльності банків' / supervisory statistics file for the branch and device series at 01/07/2026 to replace the press citation with the regulator primary.

signals.signal: Oschadbank ran Prozorro lot UA-2026-03-12-014025-a 'Relocation, dismantling, installation of ATMs, information-transaction terminals and electronic safes' at UAH 367,170 (complete), a repeat of UA-2025-01-09-009321-a (UAH 496,270). In July 2025 it bought ATM cassettes for UAH 10,684,700 (UA-2025-07-15-007950-a). No 2025-2026 Oschadbank tender for the PURCHASE of ATMs or recyclers appears in the Prozorro record.
signals.implies: Oschadbank is redeploying and life-extending its existing fleet (relocation, cassette replacement) rather than replacing it - consistent with the fleet falling from ~2,790 (Jul-2023) to ~2,200. A replacement/refresh tender has NOT yet been issued, so the window to shape the requirement is still open. Printec ATM/self-service, recyclers, managed services.
signals.likelihood: Refresh tender not yet issued; ageing fleet makes one plausible within 12-24 months
signals.followup: Set a standing Prozorro watch on EDRPOU 00032129 for CPV 30120000-6 / 'банкомат' / 'ресайклер'; approach Oschadbank IT-procurement at requirement-drafting stage, ahead of any spec.

signals.signal: NBU's open-banking framework rests on Board Resolutions No. 80 (Regulation on Open Banking in Ukraine), No. 81 (authorisation of non-financial payment service providers) and No. 82 (electronic trust services in open banking), all dated 25/07/2025. As of 31/07/2026 the NBU open-banking page lists 6 authorised third-party providers - 3 PISPs and 3 AISPs. ASPSPs (all banks) must expose base APIs with real-time account access, publish full API technical documentation on their own websites, and verify TPP authorisation against the Payment Infrastructure Register API before granting account access.
signals.source_name: National Bank of Ukraine - Open Banking
signals.implies: Every Ukrainian bank, Oschadbank and Raiffeisen included, is a mandated ASPSP that must run production-grade APIs, strong customer authentication and TPP-consent controls during 2026. Printec digital onboarding/eKYC, transaction monitoring, HSM/security and AML/compliance all attach to the SCA + consent + fraud-control layer this creates.
signals.likelihood: Live now, TPP volume ramping through 2026
signals.followup: Download Resolution No. 80 full text for the exact ASPSP compliance dates during 2026; enumerate the 6 authorised PISP/AISP names from the NBU register as the pipeline of integration counterparties.
